plan.title: feat(update): record-mode payload-root substitution so dest plans match apply

narratives.Description: Dry-run plans from the deposited tree and live apply writes the incoming tree. Bound remedy is record-mode payload-root substitution on the swap path, not a VFS overlay or immutable plan.
narratives.Origin: GitHub issue https://github.com/deftai/directive/issues/4446. Next-build is Bound-remedy on successor lean 5650414391; synthesis accepted 5650420031; verified-claims 5650419818. Stop 1 write-back 5650304081 is superseded.
narratives.Overview:
Port-record replaceTree inventories then returns without dest change. writeAgentsMd, syncConsumerXbriefSchemas, and writeConsumerGitHooks then read deftDir. Under record mode that is the pre-swap deposit, so dry-run can omit AGENTS.md (and fail on a missing dest template) while live swaps first and succeeds.

Bound remedy (5650414391):
- Prefer record-mode payload-root substitution (contentRoot into writeAgentsMd and friends). Drop universal overlay wording, or enumerate the projection set plus a read-side ban.
- Do not treat immutable-plan and read-overlay as interchangeable. Occupancy/lease stays a non-goal.
- Equivalence includes exit code and error class, with absent/malformed pre-swap template as a named case.
- No recorded plan changes the current refuse/proceed decision.

Substitution applies on the file-swap path only. already-current live does not swap, so those payload reads stay dest-rooted. Record-mode dest C3 skip stays apply-phase; do not reopen #4389.

Non-goals: dirty/undeterminable preflight (#4158), teaching the mutation ledger HOME, occupancy/common-Git-dir lease (#4445/#4444), Go installer --force, immutable plan-then-apply, moving deposit-integrity refusals into the plan phase.
narratives.Constraint: Do not reopen #4389. Occupancy and session posture are sibling scopes. CHANGELOG append-only. Do not touch sibling issues #4267 #4447 #4445 #4444 #4442.

items.title: On the file-swap path, record-mode payload reads use the incoming contentRoot for writeAgentsMd, syncConsumerXbriefSchemas, and writeConsumerGitHooks. Not a VFS overlay. already-current stays dest-rooted.
Do not treat immutable-plan and read-overlay as interchangeable. Occupancy/lease stays a non-goal.
Dry-run and live agree on exit code and error class. Named case: absent or malformed pre-swap dest template with a good incoming template.
No recorded plan, empty or not, changes the current Git refuse/proceed decision.
Deposit-integrity refusals stay apply-phase; keep the record-mode dest C3 skip. Do not reopen #4389.
Tests cover changed agents template, dest-only payload member, missing/malformed pre-swap template exit-code equivalence, and dirty-tree refuse unchanged. CHANGELOG [Unreleased].
